datasetIds.title: Source dataset IDs
datasetIds.description: Apify dataset IDs from the ingest actors (gcis, pcc, gmaps, gonghui, tax).

maxRecords.title: Max records to Airtable
maxRecords.description: Cap on the working set pushed to Airtable (free-tier limit is 1,000).

matchThreshold.title: Contact match threshold
matchThreshold.description: Min matchConfidence to auto-merge a contact-only row (else manual confirm).

counties.title: County focus
counties.description: Limit the Airtable working set to these 縣市 (e.g. ["臺中市"]). Empty = nationwide. 台/臺 variants are normalised.

maxEmployees.title: ICP size ceiling (employees)
maxEmployees.description: Drop firms whose headcount is KNOWN and above this (owner-operated ICP). Unknown-size firms are kept. Suggested 30; sweet spot <=10.

enrichDecisionMaker.title: Backfill 負責人 + status
enrichDecisionMaker.description: For the working set, fetch 負責人 (decision maker) + active status per-統編 from the GCIS company-basic API (bounded to the capped set).

gcisCompanyApiOid.title: GCIS company-basic API oid
gcisCompanyApiOid.description: OpenData dataset oid for per-統編 company-basic lookup (returns Responsible_Name + Company_Status_Desc).

keepUnmatchedLeads.title: Keep unmatched Maps leads
keepUnmatchedLeads.description: Persist phone-bearing Maps/公會 rows that matched no registry firm as standalone unverified leads (keyed by placeId/phone), filling capacity left under the cap.
